title: Surfel-based global illumination on the web
summary: This project implements surfel-based global illumination rendering in the web browser using WebGL, achieving real-time dynamic global illumination without heavy ray tracing computation.
problem_solved: Brings high-quality global illumination effects to web browsers where traditional ray tracing is too computationally expensive.
why_valuable: Enables realistic lighting effects in browser-based 3D applications, democratizing advanced rendering techniques for web developers.
